app.title: Termin: the earliest NFZ specialist appointment
app.tagline: The earliest publicly funded (NFZ) specialist appointments in Poland: where, how far, and which number to call.

form.gps_error: Could not get your location. Please type a city or postcode.
form.km_per_day: For each day sooner I am willing to travel further by:
form.km_per_day_hint: Example: at 2 km, an appointment two weeks sooner is worth a 28 km longer trip.
form.required: Type what you are looking for and where you are.

results.found: Found {n} facilities. The best match is first.
results.none: No appointments found in this area. Try a larger distance or a different service.
results.heading: Results: {label}
results.offline: You are offline. Showing the last saved results from {date}.
results.error: Something went wrong. Please try again in a moment.
results.map_label: Map of facilities in the results. The same information is in the list below.

card.script: What to say on the phone

reasons.best_balance: best balance between date and distance
reasons.faster_than_median: {days} {days_word} sooner than typical in the province
reasons.slower_than_median: {days} {days_word} later than typical in the province

alerts.no_date: the facility did not report a date, call and ask
alerts.past_date: the reported date ({date}) has passed, so the data is outdated
alerts.no_phone: no phone number in NFZ data

script.hello: Hello, I have a referral to: {benefit}{urgent}. I would like the earliest available appointment.
script.check: The NFZ search shows {date}. Is it still available? If not, what is the earliest possible date?
script.check_nodate: What is the earliest available date?
script.earlier: Can you let me know if an earlier slot becomes available?
script.referral: By when and how should I deliver the referral?
script.item_referral: the referral or the e-referral code (4 digits) and PESEL
script.item_pesel: the patient's PESEL number (for a child: the child's PESEL)
script.item_docs: medical records and test results they may ask about
script.item_pen: a calendar and pen to note the date and time
script.note: Facilities update their data about once a week, so the date shown may differ from reality.

watch.title: Watch: {label}
watch.intro: Get notified when an earlier date appears in this area. No account needed.
watch.target_ntfy_hint: Pick a hard-to-guess name and subscribe to it in the ntfy app. The topic works like a password.
watch.ok: Done! You are watching: {label}. Link to stop: {url}
watch.privacy: We only store what you enter here. Location is rounded to about 1 km. See the privacy policy.

share.copied: Link copied. You can paste it into a text message.

history.title: Earliest date over time
history.empty: Not enough history for this facility yet. History builds up from searches.
history.unknown: Not enough data to judge the trend.
history.chart_label: Chart of waiting time in days

stats.title: Waiting time: {label}, {province} province
stats.summary: Median: {median} days. Half of facilities offer a date within {p25}–{p75} days, 90% within {p90} days. Facilities with a date: {n}.

footer.disclaimer: Termin is not an official NFZ app and does not give medical advice. We show data from the public NFZ “Terminy leczenia” API, which facilities update about once a week. Always confirm by phone.
